title: Differentially Private Joint Independence Test
review_status: full-text audit complete; dHSIC permutation method, DP bootstrap counterexample, minimax results, simulations and causal-data application checked
sections_checked: DP bootstrap sensitivity and power limitation
evidence_note: Private permutation dHSIC test has privacy/level/consistency and minimax-power results; DP bootstrap dHSIC can have inconsistent power in this construction (not a general bootstrap impossibility). Evaluations include 500 level and 200 power repetitions under selected Gaussian settings and a causal-inference dataset. Dependence detection is not itself directed attribute-inference leakage measurement.

title: The Hidden Cost of Correlation: Rethinking Privacy Leakage in Local Differential Privacy
review_status: full-text audit complete; five LDP mechanisms, four-dataset CPL experiments, directed metric comparison, approximate-LDP theory, data assumptions and limitations checked
evidence_note: Studies GRR/RAPPOR/OUE/OLH/Exponential on four datasets and develops CPL analysis for approximate (epsilon,delta)-LDP. Symmetric MI/Pearson may miss directed mechanism-specific inference leakage; authors report severe CPL rare in studied datasets. Estimates depend on assumed distributions; distribution mismatch is explicitly open. Source-data replication used for some conditional-estimation experiments; no linked artifact in reviewed PDF.

title: f-Differential Privacy Filters: Validity and Approximate Solutions
review_status: full-text audit complete; adaptive validity characterization, Blackwell-chain condition, approximate GDP regimes and optimistic intermediate-q evidence checked
sections_checked: abstract and exact f-DP filter counterexample
fully adaptive CLT and approximate GDP filter
Monte Carlo results across subsampling rates
evidence_note: Natural path-wise f-DP filter invalid under fully adaptive composition without structural ordering conditions. Approximate GDP filter is proved in low/high subsampling asymptotics; paper reports optimistic accounting at q=0.1 and about 0.0125 empirical CDF discrepancy. Comparison uses single-order RDP, not multi-order RDP; this is a theorem/simulation boundary, not a production exploit.
